title: Heterogeneous Co-Evolution Learning for Tool-Efficient Search Agents with Zero Labels
abstract: arXiv:2610.39682v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Deep search agents extend language models by interleaving reasoning with external retrieval. However, effective search-agent training requires addressing two challenges beyond final-answer optimization. First, the capability frontier of agents is largely determined by training questions, whereas fixed or labeled task collections cannot adapt as agents improve. Second, outcome-only reinforcement learning treats all successful trajectories equally, even when some correct answers rely on redundant searches, creating an inherent tension between answer accuracy and tool efficiency. To address these issues, we introduce \textsc{ZEST-Search}, a zero-label and tool-efficient framework for search-agent training via heterogeneous co-evolution. Starting from unlabeled reference questions, \textsc{ZEST-Search} constructs validated search tasks online through an answer-first and evidence-path-guided generation process. translated_title: 面向零标签工具高效搜索智能体的异构协同进化学习
translated_abstract: 深度搜索智能体通过将推理与外部检索交错进行来扩展语言模型的能力。然而，有效的搜索智能体训练需要解决最终答案优化之外的两个挑战。首先，智能体的能力前沿很大程度上取决于训练问题，而固定或带标签的任务集合无法随着智能体能力的提升而自适应调整。其次，仅基于结果的强化学习对所有成功的轨迹一视同仁，即使某些正确答案依赖于冗余搜索，这在答案准确性与工具效率之间造成了内在的矛盾。为了解决这些问题，我们提出了ZEST-Search，一个通过异构协同进化实现零标签、工具高效的搜索智能体训练框架。从无标签的参考问题出发，ZEST-Search通过先答案、证据路径引导的生成过程在线构建经验证的搜索任务。一个异构提议者适应……（摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: 本文提出ZEST-Search框架，通过异构协同进化在线生成经验证的搜索任务，实现无需标签的搜索智能体训练，并同时优化答案准确性与工具使用效率。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces ZEST-Search, a zero-label, tool-efficient framework that trains search agents via heterogeneous co-evolution by generating validated search tasks online, jointly optimizing answer accuracy and tool efficiency.
